name: Beli Beli Beli ~Geu Posyeon-eun Wiheomhae~
source:
Aii, a freshman student of the "Eora Magic School", is an alchemist-in-training with ambitions of creating the legendary Love Potion, which is said to make anyone who drank it fall in love.

With the arrival of the school's magic festival, he saw an opportunity to fulfill those ambitions as he participated in the potion-making contest. But because Aii had made a mistake in making the love potion, everyone who drank it had experienced various side effects.

Now it's up to Aii to create an antidote and reverse his error before things get too bad.
translation:
Aii是“Eora魔法学校”的一年级新生，也是一名见习炼金术师。他立志调制出传说中的爱情魔药，据说喝下它的人，无一不会坠入爱河。

学校的魔法祭到来时，他报名参加魔药制作比赛，认为实现抱负的机会终于来了。然而，由于调制过程出了差错，所有喝下爱情魔药的人，都出现了不同的副作用。

现在，Aii必须在事态恶化之前，研制解药，弥补自己的错误。
